newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Salvage planned for oil rig off S.Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Salvage planned for oil rig off S.Australia.

text.p: Canyon (Australia) Pty Ltd said on Wednesday it had been advised that a drilling rig disabled during installation off the South Australian coast could be salvaged as soon as possible at a cost of around A$15 million.
Canyon spokesman Chris Rann said the rig owner/operator Maersk Drilling (Australia) Ltd APS expected the salvage operation in the Gulf St Vincent to take about three weeks.
Rann said Maersk planned to cut the rig in two and remove it for repair, possibly to Singapore.

One of the rig's legs was damaged at the weekend in the first stage of a A$15 million petroleum exploration programme by Canyon, which is 100 percent owned by private Texan based oil and gas explorer and producer Wagner and Brown Ltd.
Rann said Canyon and Maersk wanted to resume the exploration programme as soon as possible, but the availability of another rig could take some months.
